# OpenCell dial-plan vectors (numbering-plan.md v0.2 "Dial Plan"; spec
# 2026-09-27-numbering-v2-design.md §5.2). Shared by the C host tests
# (host-tests/test_sig_number.c) and the Android app
# (android/core/src/test/resources/numbers.txt, PhoneNumberTest): the two
# copies must stay identical.
#
# dialled|home|expected
#   dialled  exactly as typed, between the bars (spaces count)
#   home     the caller's own number, or - for none
#   expected the full form, or reject
#
# numbering-plan.md examples (caller +883 1 606 555 01234)
